title: Applied Purist Series Vol. I — Lean 4 Formal Verification & Silicon ABI Archive
description: Mathlib-free Lean 4.36.0 / Lake 5.0 formal verification suite (155 KERNEL_ONLY theorems, 0 sorry, 0 native_decide) for Applied Purist Vol. I: Quantitative Finance Core (10.5281/zenodo.24104901 | Companion SW 10.5281/zenodo.24133639). Formally proves O(N^2) convolution sum identity, weighted 8-mode KYP passivity M_KYP(P) < 0 with P = diag(R_1..R_8), full 4D Kustaanheimo-Stiefel (KS) spinor matrix orthogonality L(u)^T L(u) = ||u||^2 I_4, Euler four-square norm, bilinear gauge symmetry, arbitrary-N Bierman-Thornton UDU^T strict positive definiteness, 2x2 Givens SRIF norm preservation, 64-level bitwise LOB popcnt/rotl64 conservation, European call 1-Lipschitz convexity, Lasry-Lions & Table 2.1 bounds, MarketState64 64-byte WebGPU ABI, and Solinas primality.
